info.name: Command
info.description:
This Postman collection relies on variables automatically imported from scripts located in the API test GitHub repository.

These scripts initialize the test context, including:

- ACL definitions
    
- Test users
    
- Roles and permissions
    

Variables must be generated before running the collection to ensure consistent and repeatable test executions.

\--

Prerequisites:

- Clone the API test GitHub repository
    
- Pull and run the docker
    
- Copy the fixtures on docker
    
- Run script to adding fixtures
